hook_text: Two out of every three of our plants grow nowhere else on Earth. Ready for a road trip?
clip_script: A map on the floor in Kimberley. Six stops. Fynbos: proteas and a sugarbird sipping nectar. Karoo: succulents full of water, meerkats popping out of burrows. Bushveld: marula trees and elephants. Grassland: open veld and blesbok. Wetland: reeds, hippos and pink flamingos. Sea: dolphins and forests of kelp. Each habitat has its own living things, and most of our plants are found only here. That is indigenous. Where is your stop?
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with six pins; each pin opens into a small sketch of its plants and animals.
mood: Curious and proud, like a family road trip across the country.
pacing: Quick hook, six fast stops with two living things each, then the word indigenous.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and name the habitat closest to your home.
